name: Ahshislepelta
sum: Ahshislepelta is a small ankylosaurid from the Kirtland Formation of New Mexico, known from an incomplete postcranial skeleton.
holotype: A partial postcranial skeleton of a small subadult or adult found in 2005 — Hunter Wash Member, Kirtland Formation, New Mexico.
biology: Known from postcranial bones; no behavioural data.
author: Burns and Sullivan 2011

sources.text: M. E. Burns and R. M. Sullivan. 2011. A new ankylosaurid from the Upper Cretaceous Kirtland Formation, San Juan Basin, with comments on the diversity of ankylosaurids in New Mexico. Fossil Record 3. New Mexico Museum of Natural History and Science Bulletin 53:169-178
